examples.english: Horizontal stripe patterns are said to make the body look wider.

notes:
A pattern of stripes running horizontally (left to right), common in clothing and fabric design.

FORMS:
⟦{横|よこ}→横：02984_yoko⟧ (horizontal/sideways) + ⟦{縞|しま}→縞：27905_shima⟧ (stripes)

FASHION NOTE:
In Japanese fashion terminology, horizontal stripes are often called ボーダー (from English "border"). A ボーダー⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧ or ボーダーTシャツ specifically means a horizontally striped shirt.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {横縞|よこじま}: horizontal stripes (said to make the body look wider)
- ⟦{縦縞|たてじま}→縦縞：18811_tatejima⟧: vertical stripes (said to make the body look taller/slimmer)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {横縞|よこじま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{模様|もよう}→模様：03635_moyou⟧: horizontal stripe pattern
- {横縞|よこじま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧: horizontally striped shirt
- ⟦{赤|あか}→赤：02842_aka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{横縞|よこじま}: red and white horizontal stripes
